Grey: physical geometry. Blue: experimental curtain. Green: curtain portal promises. Orange: fixed measured routes. Red dots: failed endpoints. The strip changes ownership and regenerates changed briefs; this is not an isolated wall overlay or production promotion. Both panels use identical world endpoints. Use browser zoom to inspect. Old-owner loot preview shows the first 12 complete routes per body/phase plus every failed endpoint; full unrounded measurements remain in the compressed reports. Route drawing coordinates are rounded to 0.1 world unit.
